raw_html: [[Symbiotic Flexibility]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Symbiotic Flexibility]]:''' Because this suit of armor has merged with your body, the flexibility it affords you is practically unparalleled. A suit of armor that has this property has a [[Maximum dexterity bonus|maximum Dexterity bonus]] 4 higher than normal, and its [[armor check penalty]] is reduced by 4.
